name: com.kinatraa.playerprefeditor
description: Editor window to view, search, create, edit, rename, delete, import and export PlayerPrefs as formatted JSON. Lists every key from the OS store on Windows, macOS and Linux, with undo/redo, an import preview with merge or replace, value search, bulk actions and embedded-JSON editing. Game code can react to edits in Play Mode through PlayerPrefEvents.Changed. The window is Editor-only; builds only get one tiny event class that never fires there.

samples.description: A sample PlayerPrefs JSON document to try Import and Export with.
